title: ConvAbuse: Data, Analysis, and Benchmarks for Nuanced Abuse Detection in Conversational AI
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus was on detecting various types of abuse, such as sexism, sexual harassment, racism, and homophobia, directed at conversational AI.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
